en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large castle complex with a tall rectangular tower on the left, a long two-story residential wing with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, and a partially visible ornate gabled structure on the right. Ivy or vines cover the lower façade, and a few small human figures stand in front of the entrance archway. Decorative red script text appears at the top, with small vertical publisher text along the left edge.
